EV-000011

Max/min distance ratio, 14 points in R^3 (squared) · Point configurations · status current

Definition

Minimum over 14 points in R^3 of (max pairwise distance / min pairwise distance)^2.

\min_{P\subset\mathbb R^3,|P|=14}\left(\frac{\max d}{\min d}\right)^2

Domain: 14-point sets in R^3. Normalisation: squared ratio. Direction: min.

Current value

4.16578 (bound)

Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.05943 https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.05943 2026-01-09
